svg.aria-label: Left, what is given: one attention head of Qwen3-4B, with the keys K and values V of every token of a QuALITY article, a few sample queries, and a budget t for the head, a tenth of the article’s tokens overall. Right, what the agent writes: a small cache for the head in three steps. First, keep a few of the keys. Second, give each kept key a bias, so that together they draw the attention all the keys drew. Third, fit new values by least squares, so that for every sample query q, softmax of q C transposed plus beta, times C2, matches softmax of q K transposed, times V.
svg.text: a key and a value for every token
a tenth of the tokens overall
A small cache that attends the same way

g.data-tex: Give each kept key a bias $\beta$
g.text: Give each kept key a bias

g.data-tex: Fit new values $C_2$ by least squares
